subject: Draft: Collaborative evaluation plan + stakeholder heat-check

To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenwavehealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP request + timeline preference

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the model looked promising on our summarization tests. Procurement asked me to capture a short evaluation plan and a proposed timeline so they can align budget and security reviews.

Would you be able to share a MAP template you typically use (doc + a one-slide acceptance matrix)? We are aiming for a 6-week technical evaluation with a production pilot in Q2, but I want to run that by our infra and privacy teams first.

High-level questions they asked:
- Who will be our technical point of contact at Redwood?
- What customer-side tasks do you expect during the pilot (data samples, test prompts, infra access)?
- Any standard gating criteria for acceptance?

If possible, can you put together an initial draft MAP (Google Doc) and a single-slide acceptance matrix? We can then mark stakeholders and confirm dates.

Regards,
Sana Patel
Head of Product Ops, Greenwave Health
Sana.Patel@greenwavehealth.com
(415) 555-0199

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Mar 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request + timeline preference

Hi Sana — great to be aligning this early. Attaching a starter MAP (link + small acceptance matrix) and a short owner list so you can route to the right folks.

Quick answers up front:
- Technical PoC at Redwood: Marissa Cole (cc) for infra/test harness and Ben Carter for onboarding cadence.
- Customer tasks we typically expect: share a representative sample of inputs (anonymized if needed), a testing dataset for quality checks, and a sandbox endpoint for evaluation traffic. We can provide a lightweight traffic generator and a README for integration.
- Standard gating criteria: 1) functional correctness on core prompts (pass/fail tests), 2) latency SLO < 300ms p50 for the pilot payload, 3) no PII leakage in synthetic audits, 4) agreed-upon cost envelope.

I created a starter Google Doc and a one-slide acceptance matrix. Please review, add stakeholder names, and flag any missing constraints. Links below. I also attached a short XLS with suggested milestones you can edit.

Links:
- MAP draft (view/comment): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDeFG-map-template
- Acceptance slide (GSlides stub): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aSlideAcceptMatrix
- XLS milestone stub: attached (acceptance-matrix.xlsx)

Next suggested step: quick 30-min working session early next week to tag owners and lock week-by-week milestones. Does Mon 24th 10:00am PT work for you?

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_MAP_template_v2.gdoc (Google Doc link), acceptance-matrix.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Sana Patel <sana.patel@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Mar 2025 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request + timeline preference

Thanks for looping me in, Avery. Quick tech notes to drop into the MAP doc:

1) Sandbox access: we will provision a token-scoped sandbox (no PHI by default) and a lightweight ingest pipeline. We need: 10–20 representative documents (anonymized) and an example schema for the metadata you track.

2) Test harness: Redwood will provide a small Python client and cURL examples. Ben will own the onboarding checks and the traffic generator.

3) Metrics to capture during evaluation (suggested):
   - Response quality (precision/recall style metrics against labeled set)
   - Latency p50/p95, token cost per response
   - Regression delta vs baseline prompts (we can add an eval job to the MAP)

4) Gating proposal (to include in doc):
   - Week 2: integration + smoke tests (sandbox connectivity)
   - Week 4: quality check and latency verification
   - Week 6: joint acceptance run + pilot readiness review

I uploaded a lightweight acceptance matrix and added the tech owners on the right-hand column of the doc. See links Avery shared; I also attached a template test checklist to the MAP doc.

If Monday 24th 10:00am PT is still proposed, I can join that session and run through the integration checklist.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: acceptance-matrix.xlsx

From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@greenwavehealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greenwavehealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Mar 2025 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request + timeline preference

Avery / team — thanks, this is exactly what we needed.

Mon 24th 10:00am PT works for the working session — I’ve invited our infra lead (same thread) and procurement will join to confirm procurement gating items.

We reviewed the starter doc and added three stakeholder names in the doc (Product Ops, Security, and Legal). We also flagged one constraint: Greenwave requires that any data used in the sandbox be anonymized and processed through our de-identification pipeline prior to ingestion. 

Next actions I’ll take before the call:
- Share anonymized sample set (by EOD Tue)
- Add security contact and baseline compliance notes to the doc

Please bring the test harness README and the milestone XLS to the meeting so we can lock dates. Looking forward to Tuesday.

Best,
Sana
Head of Product Ops, Greenwave Health
Sana.Patel@greenwavehealth.com
